_notes: Two belt-and-suspenders denies on top of Block-Public-Access + default SSE-S3. DenyNonTLS rejects any plaintext-HTTP request. DenyUnEncryptedPutObject rejects a PutObject that isn't SSE-S3 (AES256). Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_BUCKET_NAME with your actual bucket name (3 spots) before pasting into Permissions -> Bucket policy. No account ID needed (S3 ARNs don't carry one). If you enable default SSE-S3 at the bucket level (you will), the second deny is redundant-but-harmless insurance.
